name: Isthmus Rentals
summary: Every rental near campus on one map, each value labeled with where it came from

shot.alt: Map of rentals near the UW–Madison campus, with filters and a price-colored pin for each property

hook: 605 rentals near campus on one map, every value labeled by where it came from, every gap turned into a question.
built: Leaflet, vanilla JS, Python collectors, Madison Metro GTFS

notes: 2,988 units and floor plans from 67 landlords, merged from their own sites and the UW Off-Campus Housing service.
Filters for bedrooms, price per person or per unit, distance from a landmark or your own saved places, utilities, pets and laundry. 305 Madison Metro stops come from the city’s GTFS feed.

pages.title: How it works
notes: Every value carries its source: the landlord’s site, the UW list, text read out of a description, or nothing. Unknown stays unknown instead of becoming a plausible guess.
Landlords quote rent per person or per unit and rarely say which. Each price is tagged with its evidence; when none settles it, the price is read as whichever puts one person between $800 and $1,500.
Phone and email of individual landlords who appear only on the UW list stay off the page; it links to that listing instead.
pages.caption: Where seven fields came from across all 605 properties. Solid is a source, dashed is none. Furnished is unknown for 85% of them, and the map says so.

pages.title: What the data says
notes: Closer costs more, and not just because of bedrooms: median rent per person is $1,200 within 0.4 mi of Bascom Hall and $978 at 1–1.25 mi.
Each property is one point, its median listing; shared rooms are left out. The rank correlation is −0.28 once each rent is divided by the median for its bedroom count (permutation p < 0.001).
pages.caption: Rent per person for 403 properties with a listed 1–5 bedroom rent for 2026–27 or 2027–28. The blue line is the median of each distance band (n = 29, 116, 105, 67, 38, 22, 26).
